title: LearningLogSettings
description: The learning log per game day (B2685 part B, A1620, Marcel W1947): a readable Markdown file next to the save for each game day - what each inhabitant learned, discovered, built, taught and wished, with where it came from and when. Which core events count and how their line reads (text keys, DE/EN) is data; the log only reads along (no world state, no hash, not saved: after a restart the day that was running starts its lines anew).

enabled.description: Whether the game and the headless runner write the log.

folder.description: Folder next to the save (inside the world's folder) that takes the day files.

event.description: Kind of the core event (vocabulary event).

text_key.description: Text key of the line; for knowledge_gained the source (seen, experienced, heard, guessed) is appended ('.heard'). Placeholders: {time} {thing} {is} {property} {from} {other} {need} {action}; '{is} {property}' stay together (facts of one moment are joined there).
